name: JW Marriott Nashville
insider_take: This luxury flagship sits in the heart of Music City's entertainment district, where country legends and modern maestros converge in Nashville's most vibrant neighborhood.
whats_special: The JW Marriott Nashville stands as the city's tallest hotel at 33 stories, offering unparalleled views of the Cumberland River and downtown skyline. Located just steps from the iconic Broadway honky-tonks and the historic Ryman Auditorium, this sophisticated property features locally-inspired design elements celebrating Nashville's rich musical heritage, including custom artwork from Tennessee artists and music-themed installations throughout the lobby.
pro_tip: Book a river-view room on floors 25+ for stunning sunset views over the Cumberland River and request late checkout to enjoy the rooftop pool area when it's less crowded.
dont_miss: The hotel's signature restaurant Bourbon Steak by Michael Mina offers dry-aged beef with Nashville hot seasoning, while the rooftop bar provides 360-degree city views. Walk just two blocks to experience the legendary Grand Ole Opry at the Ryman Auditorium, or stroll down Broadway to catch live music at Tootsies Orchid Lounge, where countless country stars got their start.
pros: Prime downtown location in the heart of Nashville's entertainment district
Luxurious accommodations with sophisticated design and premium amenities
Exceptional dining venues including rooftop restaurant with city views
State-of-the-art fitness center and spa facilities
cons: Busy downtown location may experience urban noise
